en: At last, Vendral is dead. Juleck's prophecy is complete: Ardania's wisest mind shall unite its strongest bodies and, with magic-forged steel, forever rid our skies of the Winged Death.

A costly battle, your Highness! But a battle well-fought. None knew the true power of the Liche Queen until we'd forced her from her lair. Given that, this has been an outstanding day! There'd be more
